title: Two Women and Shirtless Man on Pebble Beach, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from the mid-1940s depicting two smiling women standing on a pebble-covered beach or incline behind a shirtless man who is seated on a box or cooler. The women wear typical 1940s cardigans and jackets with victory-roll hairstyles, capturing a casual outdoor leisure moment during the post-WWII era.
